title: ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to amending the Economic and Workforce Development Department report dated May 22, 2025, included as…
text:
[Council File 14-1174-S40; CD 13]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to amending the Economic and Workforce Development Department report dated May 22, 2025, included as an attachment to the CRA/LA Bond Oversight Committee report dated May 28, 2025, to reflect the Community Investment Department taking the CRA/LA Excess Non-Housing Bond Proceeds project monitoring role for the Hollywood Walk of Fame Public Amenities Project.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Soto-Martinez – Hernandez):
AMEND the Economic and Workforce Development Department report dated May 28, 2025, attached to Council file No. 14-1174-S40, by removing strikethrough texts and adding underlined texts as detailed in the Motion (Soto-Martinez – Hernandez) dated September 1, 2026, attached to said Council file, and where else needed to reflect the Community Investment Department taking the CRA/LA Excess Non-Housing Bond Proceeds project monitoring role for the Hollywood Walk of Fame Public Amenities Project.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 9, 2026)

summary: Council is asked to amend a 2025 Economic and Workforce Development report so the Community Investment Department takes over monitoring of the CRA/LA bond-funded Hollywood Walk of Fame public amenities project.
